render_struct_constructor: render the constructor of a pz.Struct with an open parenthesis and qualified type name
render_short_struct_summary: render a short single-line summary of a struct with background color and pattern
struct_attr_style_fn_for_fields: build a function that renders struct attributes with italic styling for pytree node fields
handle_structs: handle rendering of a penzai struct or layer as a foldable tree node with colored background
build_foldable_tree_node_from_children: build a foldable tree node from constructor prefix, field children, and suffix for struct rendering
